source: RBI sectoral deployment of bank credit (https://www.rbi.org.in/) + https://data.gov.in/
note: SEED pack. `value` is the latest non-food bank-credit YoY growth (a financing-availability proxy); refresh from RBI/data.gov.in with scripts/refresh_macro.py --kind credit before relying on the magnitude. `neutral` is the long-run nominal-credit-growth baseline mapping to a zero nudge. `sector_sensitivity` is a maintained crosswalk of how credit-driven each sector is (0..1; NSE-Industry + yfinance) and is never touched by a fetch. tailwind = clamp(((value-neutral)/CREDIT_SCALE) * sensitivity, -1, 1). Not investment advice.
